_about: Pantry-to-Plate corpus. 17 recipes, 22 recipe-versions. The 6 Tamil Nadu cards are carried over verbatim from TamilNadu_Recipe_Cards.docx (weeks 3-11), with their prose 'Allergens:' line turned into the structured declaration fields. The other 11 are written for the capstone to cover what the brief needs: 5 recipes that exist as BOTH an 'original' (superseded) and a 'reformulated-2025' (current) version after the supplier change, poultry/meat/fish dishes for the safe-temperature chart, and quick pantry dishes. allergens = declared CONTAINS; may_contain = declared precautionary label. These two fields are the authority for every allergen decision; ingredient-level tags exist only to recompute a recipe AS SUBSTITUTED.

recipes.title: Idli
recipes.description: Steamed rice & lentil cakes, soft and fluffy
recipes.declaration_source: CMS card: 'Allergens: None (check asafoetida-free if used)'
method: Soak rice and fenugreek seeds together, and urad dal separately, for 4-6 hours.
Grind urad dal to a light, fluffy paste with cold water; grind rice coarsely.
Combine both batters, add salt, and mix well by hand to incorporate air.
Ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours until doubled and airy.
Gently mix (do not deflate too much), pour into greased idli molds.
Steam for 10-12 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Rest 2 minutes before demolding. Serve hot with sambar and chutney.
recipes.notes: Ratio % is calculated against rice weight (800 g = 100%), reflecting the classic 4:1 rice-to-dal ratio for soft idlis.

recipes.title: Dosa
recipes.description: Crisp, golden fermented rice-lentil crepe
recipes.declaration_source: CMS card: 'Allergens: None (oil used for cooking)'
method: Soak rice and fenugreek seeds, and urad dal separately, for 4-6 hours.
Grind urad dal to a smooth, aerated paste; grind rice slightly coarse.
Mix both batters with salt to a pourable, thinner-than-idli consistency.
Ferment 8-12 hours in a warm spot until bubbly and slightly risen.
Heat a flat tawa, pour a ladle of batter, and spread in a thin circular motion.
Drizzle oil around the edges; cook until golden and crisp, then fold or roll.
recipes.notes: A 3:1 rice-to-dal ratio (used here) gives a crisp dosa; increase dal slightly for softer, thicker dosas.

recipes.title: Ven Pongal
recipes.description: Comforting savory rice and moong dal porridge
method: Dry roast moong dal lightly until fragrant, then rinse with rice together.
Pressure cook rice and dal with water and salt until soft and mushy (3-4 whistles).
In a separate pan, heat ghee and fry cashews until golden; set aside.
In the same ghee, splutter cumin, crushed pepper, curry leaves, and ginger.
Pour the tempering and fried cashews over the cooked rice-dal mixture.
Mix well, adjusting consistency with hot water if needed. Serve hot with sambar or coconut chutney.
recipes.notes: Use a 2:1 rice-to-dal ratio by volume as the standard base.

recipes.title: Sambar
recipes.description: Tangy lentil stew with vegetables and spices
recipes.declaration_source: CMS card: 'Allergens: May contain gluten (some asafoetida brands use wheat flour filler)'
method: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric until soft; mash lightly and set aside.
Simmer chopped vegetables in water until just tender.
Add tamarind pulp, sambar powder, and salt to the vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked dal and simmer until the stew thickens slightly.
In a small pan, heat oil and splutter mustard seeds, asafoetida, and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the sambar and simmer 2-3 minutes more. Serve hot with rice or idli.
recipes.notes: Adjust tamarind and sambar powder to taste; regional Tamil Nadu versions vary from tangy to mildly sweet. Yield on the card is '4-6 servings'; 5 is used as the scaling base.

recipes.title: Rasam
recipes.description: Peppery, tangy tamarind-tomato soup
recipes.declaration_source: CMS card: 'Allergens: None' -- copied verbatim. NOTE the ingredient list says 'Ghee or oil', so the declaration and the ingredients disagree. Left as exported; see `python run.py check-data`.

ingredients.note: DAIRY only if ghee is used

method: Simmer tamarind pulp, tomatoes, rasam powder, garlic, and salt in water for 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the mashed toor dal and simmer gently (do not boil hard) for 5 minutes.
In a small pan, heat ghee and splutter mustard seeds, cumin, and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the rasam and remove from heat immediately.
Let it rest a few minutes for flavors to meld. Serve hot with steamed rice.
recipes.notes: Rasam should froth slightly when ready, a sign it has been simmered, not boiled.

recipes.title: Medu Vada
recipes.description: Crispy, fluffy-centered urad dal fritters
method: Soak urad dal for 3-4 hours, then drain well.
Grind to a thick, fluffy batter using minimal water; the batter should hold its shape.
Fold in chilies, ginger, pepper, cumin, curry leaves, onion, and salt.
Wet hands, shape into small donuts with a hole in the center.
Deep fry in medium-hot oil, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sambar and coconut chutney.
recipes.notes: A stiff, well-aerated batter is key to a fluffy interior.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice (Elumichai Sadam)
recipes.description: Quick tempered rice with lemon, turmeric and roasted peanuts
method: Heat oil; add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add chana dal, urad dal and peanuts; fry until golden.
Add green chili, curry leaves, asafoetida and turmeric; stir 30 seconds.
Turn off the heat, add lemon juice and salt, then fold in the cooled rice.
Rest 5 minutes so the rice absorbs the tempering. Serve at room temperature.
recipes.notes: Leftover rice works best; freshly cooked rice turns mushy.

recipes.title: Chicken Chettinad
recipes.description: Peppery Chettinad-style chicken curry
method: Dry roast peppercorns, fennel and red chilies; grind to a coarse masala.
Heat oil, fry onions until deep golden, then add curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and salt; cook until the oil separates.
Add the chicken and the ground masala; sear 5 minutes.
Add 150 ml water, cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Uncover and reduce to a thick gravy. Serve with rice or dosa.
recipes.notes: The card says 'cooked through'; the food-safety chart is the authority for doneness.

recipes.title: Lemon & Thyme Roast Chicken
recipes.description: Whole roast chicken with lemon, garlic and thyme butter
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mash butter with thyme leaves, salt and pepper.
Rub the butter under and over the skin; put halved lemon and garlic in the cavity.
Roast for about 80 minutes until golden and the juices run clear.
Rest 15 minutes before carving.
recipes.notes: Two chickens roast side by side in about the same time; they do not need double the time.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burgers
recipes.description: Grilled beef patties in sesame buns
method: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper; do not overwork.
Shape into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns; press a dimple in the centre.
Grill over high heat about 5 minutes per side until well browned.
Toast the buns and assemble.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon & Dill
recipes.description: Simple oven-baked salmon fillets
method: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray.
Lay the fillets skin-side down, brush with oil, season, top with garlic, dill and lemon.
Bake 12-15 minutes until the flesh flakes easily.

recipes.title: Quick Peanut Noodles
recipes.description: 20-minute noodles in a peanut, soy and lime sauce
method: Cook the noodles according to the packet; reserve 60 ml of the water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, lime and garlic with the reserved water.
Toss the noodles in the sauce and top with sliced spring onions.

recipes.title: Butter Shortbread
recipes.description: Classic three-ingredient butter shortbread fingers
method: Heat the oven to 160°C. Cream the butter and sugar until pale.
Sift in flour, cornflour and salt; bring together without kneading.
Press into a 20 x 30 cm tin, prick all over and mark into 24 fingers.
Bake 18-20 minutes until pale golden; cut while warm and cool in the tin.

recipes.title: Shortbread (reformulated 2025)
recipes.description: Shortbread fingers made with the 2025 baking-fat blend
recipes.reformulation_note: Supplier change 2025: butter replaced by a baking-fat blend containing almond and hazelnut oil. Blend is produced on a line that also handles peanuts.

ingredients.item: Baking-fat blend (palm, almond and hazelnut oils)

method: Heat the oven to 160°C. Beat the fat blend and sugar until smooth.
Sift in flour, cornflour and salt; bring together without kneading.
Press into a 20 x 30 cm tin, prick all over and mark into 24 fingers.
Bake 18-20 minutes until pale golden; cut while warm and cool in the tin.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy brown-butter chocolate chip cookies
method: Heat the oven to 180°C. Brown the butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk butter with both sugars, then the egg and vanilla.
Fold in flour, bicarbonate and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop 24 balls onto lined trays, 5 cm apart.
Bake 10-11 minutes until the edges set; cool 5 minutes on the tray.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies (reformulated 2025)
recipes.description: Chewy brown-butter chocolate chip cookies with the 2025 chocolate supplier
recipes.reformulation_note: Supplier change 2025: new chocolate chips made in a facility that also processes peanuts and tree nuts.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C. Brown the butter and let it cool slightly.

recipes.title: Basil Pesto Pasta
recipes.description: Fresh basil, pine nut and parmesan pesto with linguine
method: Cook the linguine in well-salted water; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Blend basil, toasted pine nuts, garlic and salt; stream in the oil, then stir in parmesan.
Toss pasta with pesto, loosening with pasta water.

recipes.title: Basil Pesto Pasta (reformulated 2025)
recipes.description: Basil and sunflower-seed pesto with linguine
recipes.reformulation_note: Supplier change 2025: pine nuts replaced with toasted sunflower seeds.
method: Cook the linguine in well-salted water; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Blend basil, sunflower seeds, garlic and salt; stream in the oil, then stir in parmesan.
Toss pasta with pesto, loosening with pasta water.

recipes.title: Honey Oat Granola Bars
recipes.description: Chewy oat, seed and raisin bars bound with butter and honey
method: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt butter and honey together; stir in oats, seeds, raisins and salt.
Press firmly into the tin and bake 25 minutes until golden at the edges.
Cool completely before cutting into 12 bars.

recipes.title: Honey Oat Granola Bars (reformulated 2025)
recipes.description: Dairy-free oat bars bound with tahini and honey
recipes.reformulation_note: Supplier change 2025: butter replaced with tahini (sesame).
method: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20 cm square tin.
Warm tahini and honey together; stir in oats, seeds, raisins and salt.
Press firmly into the tin and bake 25 minutes until golden at the edges.
Cool completely before cutting into 12 bars.

recipes.title: Walnut Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist banana loaf with toasted walnuts
method: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 900 g loaf tin.
Mix bananas, melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour, bicarbonate, salt and walnuts.
Bake about 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool 10 minutes in the tin.

recipes.title: Banana Bread (reformulated 2025)
recipes.description: Moist banana loaf, now walnut-free
recipes.reformulation_note: Supplier change 2025: walnuts removed; new flour supplier's mill also handles soy.
method: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 900 g loaf tin.
Mix bananas, melted butter, sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour, bicarbonate and salt.
Bake about 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool 10 minutes in the tin.
